scripts.prebuild: npm run atlas:all && npm run patch:phaser
scripts.audit:story: node tools/test.ts tests/story-actor-ledger.test.ts tests/story-cast-audit.test.ts tests/story-stage-action-audit.test.ts tests/story-side-actor-audit.test.ts tests/story-side-defeat-quests.test.ts tests/story-side-item-quests.test.ts tests/story-side-interaction-quests.test.ts tests/story-side-coverage.test.ts
scripts.audit:story:full: npm run audit:story && node tools/test.ts tests/story-chapters.test.ts
scripts.release:story: npm run validate:content && npm run debug-start:check && npm run audit:story && node tools/test.ts tests/save-game.test.ts tests/saved-game.test.ts tests/story-chapters.test.ts && npm run build
scripts.atlas:all: npm run atlas:icons && npm run atlas:props && npm run atlas:ui && npm run atlas:effects && npm run atlas:characters
